title: Holdback & Fallback Runway Catalog — Preflight KPIs & Readiness
description: Working sheet to catalog the holdback windows, fallback strategies, and KPI gates we use to decide go/no-go on production rollouts. Focus is on measurable signals (latency, error budget, cost per token), the mechanical steps to hold traffic, and quick fallback actions so on-call and ops can execute with minimal coordination friction. This is intentionally terse — working draft for ops runbook and preflight gating.
kpi_rows: API p99 latency|<200ms|215ms|Infra-SRE (Evan)|Enable local batching + degrade to smaller model variant|High: user impact noticed
Token cost per 1k|<$2.50|$2.10|Product-ops (Maya)|No immediate action — monitor cost curves|Medium
System error rate (5m)|<0.5%|0.9%|SRE (Tomás)|Initiate holdback 20% + alert model team|High
KV cache hit rate|>70%|63%|Serving-runtime (Lina)|Deploy cache warming and reduce TTLs|Medium-High
Queue depth (requests)|<500|420|Platform Eng (Priya)|Increase worker pool by 10% temporarily|Low
readiness_checklist: Traffic-shaping rules tested in staging (A/B) — status: done — test id: ts-2026-02-stg-9
Canary config validated: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% ramp pattern exists — status: needs-runbook doc link
Pre-authorized fallback pools (dedicated-gpu-pool-a, dedicated-gpu-pool-b) — status: partial (b not warmed)
Cost guardrails configured (auto-throttle on token-cost spike) — status: in_review — Owner: Maya
Alert thresholds pushed to oncall rotation — status: done — Slack alert channel: #sre-oncall
Customer fallback messaging templates drafted (support + legal sign-off pending) — status: draft
DB migrations / schema changes: none — quick-check OK
Can abort rollback window defined: first 30 minutes highest fidelity monitoring; full rollback decision at 2 hours
contingency_playbook: Trigger: sustained API p99 >250ms for 10min -> Action: activate holdback 30% -> Route flow to dedicated-gpu-pool-a -> Owner: Platform Eng (Priya) -> Notes: requires traffic-shaper preflight key

Trigger: error rate >1.5% 5m -> Action: automatic canary stop + scale down new model -> Action2: shift 50% traffic to previous stable model -> Owner: Serving-runtime (Lina) -> Notes: make sure model artifact tagged 'stable-v3' available
Trigger: sudden token-cost spike >40% above baseline -> Action: enable cost-throttle (cap tokens/connection) -> Owner: Product-ops (Maya) -> Notes: inform sales/CS for high-value customers

Trigger: dedicated pool depleted / GPU OOMs -> Action: failover to region fallback + notify infra incident channel -> Owner: Infra-SRE (Evan) -> Notes: region fallback requires KMS key sync (pre-checked)

Fallback: manual rollback to previous config -> Steps: 1) open rollback ticket JIRA:PRODOPS-ROLLBACK-<timestamp> 2) stop rollout pipeline 3) promote previous stable tag -> Owner: Release Eng -> Notes: include user-facing status page update
rollout_timeline_summary: Phase 0: smoke & staging (0-48h). Phase 1: 5% canary (0-2h), observe KPIs. Phase 2: 25% ramp (2-8h) with gating checks every 30m. Phase 3: 50-100% (8h-48h) with extended monitoring and cost checks. Holdback windows defined at each phase for immediate rollback/hold.
operational_play_notes: Keep a single owner for immediate holdback decisions during first 2 hours (suggested: Maya)
Pre-authorize two engineers from SRE and Platform who can execute traffic-shaper commands — list pinned in Slack thread
Run a dry-run of traffic shift in staging with synthetic traffic that mimics 95th percentile payloads
Confirm that observability dashboards have real-time token-cost per route and per-model breakdowns
Double-check rate-limit rules for partners/whitelisted accounts so they are not inadvertently throttled during holdback

Schedule a 30-minute tabletop drill next week to rehearse holdback + failover scenarios
